svg.text: The test engine rejects oversized collections before
Scenario: The installed Zod rejects oversized arrays, sets and maps before visiting their elements

g.text: Given the test engine has a regression for collection size limits and
The real regression test counts element validations. For arrays, sets and maps, an oversized
collection must be rejected with no element visited. A collection inside the limit must still
validate its member and preserve its value.
Then the installed test engine passes the collection size regression
The task runs the regression against the Zod installed in this test image. The passing test proves both rejection before
element traversal and validation of accepted values. Only measured execution times are hidden.
